About us

Two people, one workshop, and a lot of leather. We started in 2019 and still answer every email ourselves. Our process is simple: you tell us your size and the model, we cut and stitch by hand, and we ship. Nothing fancy, nothing outsourced, and every pair can come back to us for repairs. We keep this page short on purpose, but long enough to count as served content in the fixture so the auditor sees words without needing JavaScript to show them.
